decision.rationale: TXN-007934 (11268 EUR cents, HARBOUR SERVICE STATIO, MER-000048) is on card CRD-000164. It was posted on 2026-08-12 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28. That is 77 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The payment's authorisation, AUTH-008140, shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true, 3-D Secure NOT_APPLICABLE, fraud flag false, and it was approved. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, a chip payment with the PIN verified and no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, because the card and PIN were both present. The cardholder also says the card never left them. The card had earlier approved purchases at the same merchant: TXN-007933 (2026-06-11, 10233) and TXN-007932 (2026-06-26, 6139). These support the decline. The statement contains no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The payment was made with your card's chip and the correct PIN was entered, with no sign of fraud. The card has also been used at this merchant before, so we treat the payment as made by you.
